raw_segments.text: We shall get you off cannily, Dick, and it will be better both for your sake and for
that of the poor creature in yonder.
I have striven long to avoid exposure and I should not like it to come at last.
Here Carter, help him on with his waistcoat.
Where did you leave your furred cloak?
You can't travel a mile without that, I know, in this damned cold climate.
In your room, Jane, run down to Mr. Mason's room, the one next mine, and fetch a cloak
